pages with nav order (issue #6).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\n\nimport pytest\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom app.main import create_app\nfrom app.publish import render_site\nfrom conftest import DEMO_USERS, csrf_token, login, visible\nfrom test_t02_updates import save_edit, slug_on\nfrom test_t03_publish import LINK, create, export, post_status_form, publish_new\n\nNEW_PAGE = \"/admin/pages/new\"\n\n\ndef create_page(client: TestClient, title: str, body: str = \"\", **extra) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Save a new page and return its edit URL.\"\"\"\n    data = {\"title\": title, \"body\": body, \"csrf_token\": csrf_token(client, NEW_PAGE), **extra}\n    response = client.post(\"/admin/pages\", data=data, follow_redirects=False)\n    assert response.status_code == 303, response.text\n    return response.headers[\"location\"]\n\n\ndef publish_page(client: TestClient, title: str, body: str = \"\", **extra) -> str:\n    url = create_page(client, title, body, **extra)\n    assert post_status_form(client, url, \"publish\").status_code == 303\n    return url\n\n\ndef restarted_admin() -> TestClient:\n    client = TestClient(create_app())\n    login(client, DEMO_USERS[\"admin\"][\"email\"], DEMO_USERS[\"admin\"][\"password\"])\n    return client\n\n\ndef nav_titles(html: str) -> list[str]:\n    nav = re.search(r'<nav class=\"site-nav\".*?</nav>', html, re.S)\n    assert nav, \"no site navigation\"\n    return [visible(a) for a in re.findall(r\"<a [^>]*>.*?</a>\", nav.group(0), re.S)]\n\n\n# --- drafts, publishing, and permissions ----------------------------------\n\ndef test_editor_creates_a_page_as_a_draft_with_all_the_update_fields(client_as):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    page = editor.get(create_page(editor, \"Roster (sample)\", \"A **list**.\")).text\n    text = visible(page)\n    assert 'value=\"Roster (sample)\"' in page\n    assert \"Status: Draft\" in text and \"Author: Sample Editor\" in text\n    assert slug_on(page) == \"roster-sample\"\n    assert re.search(r\"Created \\d{4}-\\d\\d-\\d\\d \\d\\d:\\d\\d\", text)\n    assert re.search(r\"Updated \\d{4}-\\d\\d-\\d\\d \\d\\d:\\d\\d\", text)\n    assert re.search(r\"Nav order: \\d+\", text)\n    assert \"<strong>list</strong>\" in page\n    assert \"Roster (sample)\" in editor.get(\"/admin/pages\").text\n\n\ndef test_editor_edits_a_page_draft(client_as):\n    admin, editor = client_as(\"admin\"), client_as(\"editor\")\n    url = create_page(admin, \"Schedule (sample)\")\n    assert save_edit(editor, url, \"Schedule fixed (sample)\").status_code == 303\n    assert 'value=\"Schedule fixed (sample)\"' in admin.get(url).text\n\n\ndef test_page_markdown_is_sanitized_in_the_preview(client_as):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    page = editor.get(create_page(editor, \"XSS page\", \"<script>alert(1)</script>\")).text\n    assert \"<script>alert\" not in page\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"verb\", [\"publish\", \"unpublish\"])\ndef test_editor_cannot_publish_or_unpublish_a_page(client_as, verb):\n    admin, editor = client_as(\"admin\"), client_as(\"editor\")\n    url = create_page(admin, \"History (sample)\")\n    if verb == \"unpublish\":\n        post_status_form(admin, url, \"publish\")\n    before = re.search(r\"Status: \\w+\", visible(admin.get(url).text)).group(0)\n    response = post_status_form(editor, url, verb)\n    assert response.status_code == 403 and \"Not allowed\" in visible(response.text)\n    assert before in visible(admin.get(url).text)\n\n\ndef test_editor_cannot_edit_or_delete_a_published_page(client_as):\n    admin, editor = client_as(\"admin\"), client_as(\"editor\")\n    url = publish_page(editor and admin, \"About (sample)\")\n    refused = editor.post(url, data={\"title\": \"Changed\", \"body\": \"\",\n                                     \"csrf_token\": csrf_token(editor, NEW_PAGE)},\n                          follow_redirects=False)\n    assert refused.status_code == 403 and \"Not allowed\" in visible(refused.text)\n    assert editor.get(f\"{url}/delete\").status_code == 403\n    assert 'value=\"About (sample)\"' in admin.get(url).text\n\n\ndef test_editor_cannot_delete_someone_elses_page_draft(client_as):\n    admin, editor = client_as(\"admin\"), client_as(\"editor\")\n    url = create_page(admin, \"Admin page (sample)\")\n    assert editor.get(f\"{url}/delete\").status_code == 403\n    assert editor.get(url).status_code == 200\n\n\ndef delete(client: TestClient, url: str):\n    return client.post(f\"{url}/delete\", data={\"csrf_token\": csrf_token(client, f\"{url}/delete\")},\n                       follow_redirects=False)\n\n\ndef test_editor_deletes_their_own_page_draft(client_as):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    url = create_page(editor, \"Abandoned page (sample)\")\n    assert delete(editor, url).status_code == 303\n    assert editor.get(url).status_code == 404\n\n\ndef test_admin_deletes_a_published_page_after_a_confirm_step(client_as, tmp_path):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    url = publish_page(admin, \"Results (sample)\", \"Pull these words\")\n    confirm = visible(admin.get(f\"{url}/delete\").text)\n    assert \"Delete \\u201cResults (sample)\\u201d?\" in confirm and \"This page is published\" in confirm\n    assert delete(admin, url).status_code == 303\n    assert \"Results (sample)\" not in \"\\n\".join(export(tmp_path).values())\n\n\n# --- persistence ---------------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef test_page_create_edit_publish_unpublish_delete_persist_across_a_restart(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    url = create_page(admin, \"Persisted (sample)\")\n    assert 'value=\"Persisted (sample)\"' in restarted_admin().get(url).text\n\n    save_edit(admin, url, \"Persisted edit (sample)\", nav_order=\"7\")\n    page = visible(restarted_admin().get(url).text)\n    assert \"Nav order: 7\" in page or 'value=\"7\"' in restarted_admin().get(url).text\n    assert \"Persisted edit (sample)\" in restarted_admin().get(url).text\n\n    post_status_form(admin, url, \"publish\")\n    assert \"Status: Published\" in visible(restarted_admin().get(url).text)\n    post_status_form(admin, url, \"unpublish\")\n    assert \"Status: Draft\" in visible(restarted_admin().get(url).text)\n\n    delete(admin, url)\n    assert restarted_admin().get(url).status_code == 404\n\n\n# --- nav order -----------------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef test_admin_sets_a_pages_nav_order(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    url = create_page(admin, \"Ordered (sample)\", nav_order=\"3\")\n    assert 'name=\"nav_order\" value=\"3\"' in admin.get(url).text\n    assert save_edit(admin, url, \"Ordered (sample)\", nav_order=\"9\").status_code == 303\n    assert pages with nav order (issue #6).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\n\nimport pytest\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom app.main import create_app\nfrom app.publish import render_site\nfrom conftest import DEMO_USERS, csrf_token, login, visible\nfrom test_t02_updates import save_edit, slug_on\nfrom test_t03_publish import LINK, create, export, post_status_form, publish_new\n\nNEW_PAGE = \"/admin/pages/new\"\n\n\ndef create_page(client: TestClient, title: str, body: str = \"\", **extra) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Save a new page and return its edit URL.\"\"\"\n    data = {\"title\": title, \"body\": body, \"csrf_token\": csrf_token(client, NEW_PAGE), **extra}\n    response = client.post(\"/admin/pages\", data=data, follow_redirects=False)\n    assert response.status_code == 303, response.text\n    return response.headers[\"location\"]\n\n\ndef publish_page(client: TestClient, title: str, body: str = \"\", **extra) -> str:\n    url = create_page(client, title, body, **extra)\n    assert post_status_form(client, url, \"publish\").status_code == 303\n    return url\n\n\ndef restarted_admin() -> TestClient:\n    client = TestClient(create_app())\n    login(client, DEMO_USERS[\"admin\"][\"email\"], DEMO_USERS[\"admin\"][\"password\"])\n    return client\n\n\ndef nav_titles(html: str) -> list[str]:\n    nav = re.search(r'<nav class=\"site-nav\".*?</nav>', html, re.S)\n    assert nav, \"no site navigation\"\n    return [visible(a) for a in re.findall(r\"<a [^>]*>.*?</a>\", nav.group(0), re.S)]\n\n\n# --- drafts, publishing, and permissions ----------------------------------\n\ndef test_editor_creates_a_page_as_a_draft_with_all_the_update_fields(client_as):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    page = editor.get(create_page(editor, \"Roster (sample)\", \"A **list**.\")).text\n    text = visible(page)\n    assert 'value=\"Roster (sample)\"' in page\n    assert \"Status: Draft\" in text and \"Author: Sample Editor\" in text\n    assert slug_on(page) == \"roster-sample\"\n    assert re.search(r\"Created \\d{4}-\\d\\d-\\d\\d \\d\\d:\\d\\d\", text)\n    assert re.search(r\"Updated \\d{4}-\\d\\d-\\d\\d \\d\\d:\\d\\d\", text)\n    assert re.search(r\"Nav order: \\d+\", text)\n    assert \"<strong>list</strong>\" in page\n    assert \"Roster (sample)\" in editor.get(\"/admin/pages\").text\n\n\ndef test_editor_edits_a_page_draft(client_as):\n    admin, editor = client_as(\"admin\"), client_as(\"editor\")\n    url = create_page(admin, \"Schedule (sample)\")\n    assert save_edit(editor, url, \"Schedule fixed (sample)\").status_code == 303\n    assert 'value=\"Schedule fixed (sample)\"' in admin.get(url).text\n\n\ndef test_page_markdown_is_sanitized_in_the_preview(client_as):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    page = editor.get(create_page(editor, \"XSS page\", \"<script>alert(1)</script>\")).text\n    assert \"<script>alert\" not in page\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"verb\", [\"publish\", \"unpublish\"])\ndef test_editor_cannot_publish_or_unpublish_a_page(client_as, verb):\n    admin, editor = client_as(\"admin\"), client_as(\"editor\")\n    url = create_page(admin, \"History (sample)\")\n    if verb == \"unpublish\":\n        post_status_form(admin, url, \"publish\")\n    before = re.search(r\"Status: \\w+\", visible(admin.get(url).text)).group(0)\n    response = post_status_form(editor, url, verb)\n    assert response.status_code == 403 and \"Not allowed\" in visible(response.text)\n    assert before in visible(admin.get(url).text)\n\n\ndef test_editor_cannot_edit_or_delete_a_published_page(client_as):\n    admin, editor = client_as(\"admin\"), client_as(\"editor\")\n    url = publish_page(editor and admin, \"About (sample)\")\n    refused = editor.post(url, data={\"title\": \"Changed\", \"body\": \"\",\n                                     \"csrf_token\": csrf_token(editor, NEW_PAGE)},\n                          follow_redirects=False)\n    assert refused.status_code == 403 and \"Not allowed\" in visible(refused.text)\n    assert editor.get(f\"{url}/delete\").status_code == 403\n    assert 'value=\"About (sample)\"' in admin.get(url).text\n\n\ndef test_editor_cannot_delete_someone_elses_page_draft(client_as):\n    admin, editor = client_as(\"admin\"), client_as(\"editor\")\n    url = create_page(admin, \"Admin page (sample)\")\n    assert editor.get(f\"{url}/delete\").status_code == 403\n    assert editor.get(url).status_code == 200\n\n\ndef delete(client: TestClient, url: str):\n    return client.post(f\"{url}/delete\", data={\"csrf_token\": csrf_token(client, f\"{url}/delete\")},\n                       follow_redirects=False)\n\n\ndef test_editor_deletes_their_own_page_draft(client_as):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    url = create_page(editor, \"Abandoned page (sample)\")\n    assert delete(editor, url).status_code == 303\n    assert editor.get(url).status_code == 404\n\n\ndef test_admin_deletes_a_published_page_after_a_confirm_step(client_as, tmp_path):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    url = publish_page(admin, \"Results (sample)\", \"Pull these words\")\n    confirm = visible(admin.get(f\"{url}/delete\").text)\n    assert \"Delete \\u201cResults (sample)\\u201d?\" in confirm and \"This page is published\" in confirm\n    assert delete(admin, url).status_code == 303\n    assert \"Results (sample)\" not in \"\\n\".join(export(tmp_path).values())\n\n\n# --- persistence ---------------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef test_page_create_edit_publish_unpublish_delete_persist_across_a_restart(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    url = create_page(admin, \"Persisted (sample)\")\n    assert 'value=\"Persisted (sample)\"' in restarted_admin().get(url).text\n\n    save_edit(admin, url, \"Persisted edit (sample)\", nav_order=\"7\")\n    page = visible(restarted_admin().get(url).text)\n    assert \"Nav order: 7\" in page or 'value=\"7\"' in restarted_admin().get(url).text\n    assert \"Persisted edit (sample)\" in restarted_admin().get(url).text\n\n    post_status_form(admin, url, 'name=\"nav_order\" value=\"9\"' in admin.get(url).text\n\n\ndef test_nav_order_must_be_a_whole_number(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    url = create_page(admin, \"Ordered (sample)\", assert save_edit(admin, url, \"Old name (sample)\", slug=\"New Name! 2026\").status_code == 303\n    assert slug_on(admin.get(url).text) == \"new-name-2026\"\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"kind\", {"parentUuid":"992287dc-9f23-431e-b152-1354dbf2d468","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CfzNBg5JRPEXWN3HEjx4z","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01SUuWwLQVz1Y9XUEEmBv4Ub","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/content.py","content":"\"\"\"Updates and pages: the two kinds of content (see CONTEXT.md).\n\nBoth have the same fields and rules: a title, a slug, a Markdown body, a status\n(draft or published), an author, and created and updated timestamps. Pages add\na nav order. New content is always a draft.\n\nA slug is made from the title on first save and changes only when the admin\nasks. Slugs are unique across updates and pages together, because both are\nfiles in the same exported site; \"index\" is reserved for the home page.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\nimport unicodedata\nfrom datetime import datetime, timezone\n\nfrom app import db\n\n\nclass InvalidContent(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"The form cannot be saved; the message is shown to the user.\"\"\"\n\n\nTABLES = (\"posts\", \"pages\")\nRESERVED_SLUGS = {\"index\"}\n\n\ndef slugify(text: str) -> str:\n    # Strip accents (é -> e); any other non-ASCII character separates words.\n    plain = \"\".join(c for c in unicodedata.normalize(\"NFKD\", text)\n                    if not unicodedata.combining(c))\n    return re.sub(r\"[^a-z0-9]+\", \"-\", plain.lower()).strip(\"-\")\n\n\ndef _unique_slug(conn: sqlite3.Connection, text: str, fallback: str) -> str:\n    base = slugify(text) or fallback\n    taken = set(RESERVED_SLUGS)\n    for table in TABLES:\n        taken |= {row[\"slug\"] for row in conn.execute(\n            f\"SELECT slug FROM {table} WHERE slug = ? OR slug LIKE ?\", (base, f\"{base}-%\"))}\n    slug, n = base, 2\n    while slug in taken:\n        slug, n = f\"{base}-{n}\", n + 1\n    return slug\n\n\ndef _now() -> str:\n    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec=\"seconds\")\n\n\ndef _clean_title(title: str) -> str:\n    title = title.strip()\n    if not title:\n        raise InvalidContent(\"The title cannot be empty.\")\n    return title\n\n\ndef parse_nav_order(value: str) -> int:\n    try:\n        return int(value.strip())\n    except ValueError:\n        raise InvalidContent(\"Nav order must be a whole number, like 10.\") from None\n\n\nclass Store:\n    \"\"\"One kind of content, kept in its own table.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, table: str, noun: str, plural: str, *, published_order: str,\n                 has_nav_order: bool = False):\n        self.table, self.noun, self.plural = table, noun, plural\n        self.has_nav_order = has_nav_order\n        self._published_order = published_order\n        nav = f\"{table}.nav_order, \" if has_nav_order else \"\"\n        self._select = (\n            f\"SELECT {table}.id, title, slug, body, status, {table}.created_at, updated_at, \"\n            f\"{nav}{table}.author_id, users.name AS author \"\n            f\"FROM {table} JOIN users ON users.id = {table}.author_id\"\n        )\n\n    def create(self, title: str, body: str, author_id: int,\n               nav_order: int | None = None) -> int:\n        title = _clean_title(title)\n        now = _now()\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            columns = [\"title\", \"slug\", \"body\", \"status\", \"author_id\", \"created_at\", \"updated_at\"]\n            values = [title, _unique_slug(conn, title, self.noun), body, \"draft\",\n                      author_id, now, now]\n            if self.has_nav_order:\n                if nav_order is None:  # a new page goes to the end of the menu\n                    nav_order = conn.execute(\n                        f\"SELECT COALESCE(MAX(nav_order), 0) + 1 FROM {self.table}\").fetchone()[0]\n                columns.append(\"nav_order\")\n                values.append(nav_order)\n            cursor = conn.execute(\n                f\"INSERT INTO {self.table} ({', '.join(columns)}) \"\n                f\"VALUES ({', '.join('?' * len(values))})\", values)\n            return cursor.lastrowid\n\n    def edit(self, item_id: int, title: str, body: str, *, slug: str | None = None,\n             nav_order: int | None = None) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Save an edit. A new slug is made URL-safe and unique; None keeps it.\"\"\"\n        title = _clean_title(title)\n        changes = {\"title\": title, \"body\": body, \"updated_at\": _now()}\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            if slug is not None:\n                current = conn.execute(f\"SELECT slug FROM {self.table} WHERE id = ?\",\n                                       (item_id,)).fetchone()\n                if current and slugify(slug) not in (\"\", current[\"slug\"]):\n                    changes[\"slug\"] = _unique_slug(conn, slug, self.noun)\n            if nav_order is not None and self.has_nav_order:\n                changes[\"nav_order\"] = nav_order\n            conn.execute(\n                f\"UPDATE {self.table} SET {', '.join(f'{k} = ?' for k in changes)} WHERE id = ?\",\n                (*changes.values(), item_id))\n\n    def publish(self, item_id: int) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Mark published. Going live counts as an update, so fans see a fresh date.\"\"\"\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            conn.execute(f\"UPDATE {self.table} SET status = 'published', updated_at = ? \"\n                         \"WHERE id = ?\", (_now(), item_id))\n\n    def unpublish(self, item_id: int) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Back to draft. The next `cms publish` removes it from the site.\"\"\"\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            conn.execute(f\"UPDATE {self.table} SET status = 'draft' WHERE id = ?\", (item_id,))\n\n    def delete(self, item_id: int) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Gone for good. If it was published, the next `cms publish` removes it.\"\"\"\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            conn.execute(f\"DELETE FROM {self.table} WHERE id = ?\", (item_id,))\n\n    def get(self, item_id: int) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            return conn.execute(f\"{self._select} WHERE {self.table}.id = ?\",\n                                (item_id,)).fetchone()\n\n    def list_all(self) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            return conn.execute(f\"{self._select} \"\n                                f\"ORDER BY updated_at DESC, {self.table}.id DESC\").fetchall()\n\n    def list_published(self) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n        \"\"\"What `cms publish` exports, in the order the public site shows it.\"\"\"\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            return conn.execute(f\"{self._select} WHERE status = 'published' \"\n                                f\"ORDER BY {self._published_order}\").fetchall()\n\n\n# The home page orders updates by when they were first written, not updated_at,\n# so a correction never jumps above a newer update (CONTEXT.md, Decisions).\nUPDATES = Store(\"posts\", \"update\", \"updates\",\n                published_order=\"posts.created_at DESC, posts.id DESC\")\nPAGES = Store(\"pages\", \"page\", \"pages\", has_nav_order=True,\n              published_order=\"pages.nav_order, pages.title, pages.id\")\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":879,"cache_read_input_tokens":81295,"output_tokens":2567,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":19},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":879,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":2567,"cache_read_input_tokens":81295,"cache_creation_input_tokens":879,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":879},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_01SUuWwLQVz1Y9XUEEmBv4Ub":{"file_path":"/Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/content.py","content":"\"\"\"Updates {"parentUuid":"c9ea92b5-81f0-47bd-9a3b-9968c049144e","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"a5562329-995b-4707-987c-82232d648936","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01SUuWwLQVz1Y9XUEEmBv4Ub","type":"tool_result","content":"File created successfully at: /Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/content.py (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"uuid":"98daf17a-e789-4649-ad7b-cf2a6d672064","timestamp":"2026-10-13T14:07:23.974Z","toolUseResult":{"type":"create","filePath":"/Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/content.py","content":"\"\"\"Updates and pages: the two kinds of content (see CONTEXT.md).\n\nBoth have the same fields and rules: a title, a slug, a Markdown body, a status\n(draft or published), an author, and created and updated timestamps. Pages add\na nav order. New content is always a draft.\n\nA slug is made from the title on first save and changes only when the admin\nasks. Slugs are unique across updates and pages together, because both are\nfiles in the same exported site; \"index\" is reserved for the home page.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\nimport unicodedata\nfrom datetime import datetime, timezone\n\nfrom app import db\n\n\nclass InvalidContent(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"The form cannot be saved; the message is shown to the user.\"\"\"\n\n\nTABLES = (\"posts\", \"pages\")\nRESERVED_SLUGS = {\"index\"}\n\n\ndef slugify(text: str) -> str:\n    # Strip accents (é -> e); any other non-ASCII character separates words.\n    plain = \"\".join(c for c in unicodedata.normalize(\"NFKD\", text)\n                    if not unicodedata.combining(c))\n    return re.sub(r\"[^a-z0-9]+\", \"-\", plain.lower()).strip(\"-\")\n\n\ndef _unique_slug(conn: sqlite3.Connection, text: str, fallback: str) -> str:\n    base = slugify(text) or fallback\n    taken = set(RESERVED_SLUGS)\n    for table in TABLES:\n        taken |= {row[\"slug\"] for row in conn.execute(\n            f\"SELECT slug FROM {table} WHERE slug = ? OR slug LIKE ?\", (base, f\"{base}-%\"))}\n    slug, n = base, 2\n    while slug in taken:\n        slug, n = f\"{base}-{n}\", n + 1\n    return slug\n\n\ndef _now() -> str:\n    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec=\"seconds\")\n\n\ndef _clean_title(title: str) -> str:\n    title = title.strip()\n    if not title:\n        raise InvalidContent(\"The title cannot be empty.\")\n    return title\n\n\ndef parse_nav_order(value: str) -> int:\n    try:\n        return int(value.strip())\n    except ValueError:\n        raise InvalidContent(\"Nav order must be a whole number, like 10.\") from None\n\n\nclass Store:\n    \"\"\"One kind of content, kept in its own table.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, table: str, noun: str, plural: str, *, published_order: str,\n                 has_nav_order: bool = False):\n        self.table, self.noun, self.plural = table, noun, plural\n        self.has_nav_order = has_nav_order\n        self._published_order = published_order\n        nav = f\"{table}.nav_order, \" if has_nav_order else \"\"\n        self._select = (\n            f\"SELECT {table}.id, title, slug, body, status, {table}.created_at, updated_at, \"\n            f\"{nav}{table}.author_id, users.name AS author \"\n            f\"FROM {table} JOIN users ON users.id = {table}.author_id\"\n        )\n\n    def create(self, title: str, body: str, author_id: int,\n               nav_order: int | None = None) -> int:\n        title = _clean_title(title)\n        now = _now()\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            columns = [\"title\", \"slug\", \"body\", \"status\", \"author_id\", \"created_at\", \"updated_at\"]\n            values = [title, _unique_slug(conn, title, self.noun), body, \"draft\",\n                      author_id, now, now]\n            if self.has_nav_order:\n                if nav_order is None:  # a new page goes to the end of the menu\n                    nav_order = conn.execute(\n                        f\"SELECT COALESCE(MAX(nav_order), 0) + 1 FROM {self.table}\").fetchone()[0]\n                columns.append(\"nav_order\")\n                values.append(nav_order)\n            cursor = conn.execute(\n                f\"INSERT INTO {self.table} ({', '.join(columns)}) \"\n                f\"VALUES ({', '.join('?' * len(values))})\", values)\n            return cursor.lastrowid\n\n    def edit(self, item_id: int, title: str, body: str, *, slug: str | None = None,\n             nav_order: int | None = None) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Save an edit. A new slug is made URL-safe and unique; None keeps it.\"\"\"\n        title = _clean_title(title)\n        changes = {\"title\": title, \"body\": body, \"updated_at\": _now()}\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            if slug is not None:\n                current = conn.execute(f\"SELECT slug FROM {self.table} WHERE id = ?\",\n                                       (item_id,)).fetchone()\n                if current and slugify(slug) not in (\"\", current[\"slug\"]):\n                    changes[\"slug\"] = _unique_slug(conn, slug, self.noun)\n            if nav_order is not None and self.has_nav_order:\n                changes[\"nav_order\"] = nav_order\n            conn.execute(\n                f\"UPDATE {self.table} SET {', '.join(f'{k} = ?' for k in changes)} WHERE id = ?\",\n                (*changes.values(), item_id))\n\n    def publish(self, item_id: int) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Mark published. Going live counts as an update, so fans see a fresh date.\"\"\"\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            conn.execute(f\"UPDATE {self.table} SET status = 'published', updated_at = ? \"\n                         \"WHERE id = ?\", (_now(), item_id))\n\n    def unpublish(self, item_id: int) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Back to draft. The next `cms publish` removes it from the site.\"\"\"\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            conn.execute(f\"UPDATE {self.table} SET status = 'draft' WHERE id = ?\", (item_id,))\n\n    def delete(self, item_id: int) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Gone for good. If it was published, the next `cms publish` removes it.\"\"\"\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            conn.execute(f\"DELETE FROM {self.table} WHERE id = ?\", (item_id,))\n\n    def get(self, item_id: int) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            return conn.execute(f\"{self._select} WHERE {self.table}.id = ?\",\n                                (item_id,)).fetchone()\n\n    def list_all(self) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            return conn.execute(f\"{self._select} \"\n                                f\"ORDER BY updated_at DESC, {self.table}.id DESC\").fetchall()\n\n    def list_published(self) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n        \"\"\"What `cms publish` exports, in the order the public site shows it.\"\"\"\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            return conn.execute(f\"{self._select} WHERE status = 'published' \"\n                                f\"ORDER BY {self._published_order}\").fetchall()\n\n\n# The home page orders updates by when they were first written, not updated_at,\n# so a correction never jumps above a newer update (CONTEXT.md, Decisions).\nUPDATES = Store(\"posts\", \"update\", \"updates\",\n                published_order=\"posts.created_at DESC, posts.id DESC\")\nPAGES = Store(\"pages\", \"page\", \"pages\", has_nav_order=True,\n              published_order=\"pages.nav_order, pages.title, pages.id\")\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"c9ea92b5-81f0-47bd-9a3b-9968c049144e","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"a121db57-1bee-4dbb-8856-8744e70c4142","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"afcf6f29-4133-4319-8044-e192682b7663","version":"2.1.296","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"b582297a-0b1e-4535-8ef2-46298ec5b2c9","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CfzNDwvMVB6kNbX5W7LAG","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_014WP7NHGyBvxXoaPNf82eNF","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/permissions.py","content":"\"\"\"Who may change which update or page (spec #1, Permissions).\n\nThe admin may do anything. An editor may edit any draft and delete only their\nown drafts; published content is the admin's alone, and so are slugs and nav\norder. The `may_*` functions answer for templates; the `check_*` functions\nraise Refused for routes, and the refused screen shows the reason.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\n\nfrom app.auth import Refused\n\nPUBLISHED_IS_ADMIN_ONLY = (\"This is published, so only the admin can change or \"\n                           \"delete it. Editors can edit drafts only.\")\nOWN_DRAFTS_ONLY = \"Editors can delete only their own drafts. Ask the author or the admin.\"\nSLUG_IS_ADMIN_ONLY = \"Only the admin can change a slug.\"\nNAV_ORDER_IS_ADMIN_ONLY = \"Only the admin can set a page's nav order.\"\n\n\ndef is_admin(user: sqlite3.Row) -> bool:\n    return user[\"role\"] == \"admin\"\n\n\ndef may_edit(user: sqlite3.Row, item: sqlite3.Row) -> bool:\n    return is_admin(user) or item[\"status\"] == \"draft\"\n\n\ndef may_delete(user: sqlite3.Row, item: sqlite3.Row) -> bool:\n    return is_admin(user) or (item[\"status\"] == \"draft\"\n                              and item[\"author_id\"] == user[\"id\"])\n\n\ndef check_edit(user: sqlite3.Row, item: sqlite3.Row) -> None:\n    if not may_edit(user, item):\n        raise Refused(PUBLISHED_IS_ADMIN_ONLY)\n\n\ndef check_delete(user: sqlite3.Row, item: sqlite3.Row) -> None:\n    check_edit(user, item)\n    if not may_delete(user, item):\n        raise Refused(OWN_DRAFTS_ONLY)\n\n\ndef check_admin_fields(user: sqlite3.Row, item: sqlite3.Row | None, *,\n                       slug: str | None, nav_order: str | None) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Refuse an editor whose form changes the slug or nav order. Sending the\n    current value back unchanged is fine; `item` is None for new content.\"\"\"\n    if is_admin(user):\n        return\n    if slug and (item is None or slug.strip() != item[\"slug\"]):\n        raise Refused(SLUG_IS_ADMIN_ONLY)\n    if nav_order and nav_order.strip() and (\n            item is None or nav_order.strip() != str(item[\"nav_order\"])):\n        raise Refused(NAV_ORDER_IS_ADMIN_ONLY)\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1432,"cache_read_input_tokens":84822,"output_tokens":1008,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1432,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":1008,"cache_read_input_tokens":84822,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1432,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1432},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_014WP7NHGyBvxXoaPNf82eNF":{"file_path":"/Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/permissions.py","content":"\"\"\"Who may change which update or page (spec #1, Permissions).\n\nThe admin may do anything. An editor may edit any draft and delete only their\nown drafts; published content is the admin's alone, and so are slugs and nav\norder. The `may_*` functions answer for templates; the `check_*` functions\nraise Refused for routes, and the refused screen shows the reason.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\n\nfrom app.auth import Refused\n\nPUBLISHED_IS_ADMIN_ONLY = (\"This is published, so only the admin can change or \"\n                           \"delete it. Editors can edit drafts only.\")\nOWN_DRAFTS_ONLY = \"Editors can delete only their own drafts. Ask the author or the admin.\"\nSLUG_IS_ADMIN_ONLY = \"Only the admin can change a slug.\"\nNAV_ORDER_IS_ADMIN_ONLY = \"Only the admin can set a page's nav order.\"\n\n\ndef is_admin(user: sqlite3.Row) -> bool:\n    return user[\"role\"] == \"admin\"\n\n\ndef may_edit(user: sqlite3.Row, item: sqlite3.Row) -> bool:\n    return is_admin(user) or item[\"status\"] == \"draft\"\n\n\ndef may_delete(user: sqlite3.Row, item: sqlite3.Row) -> bool:\n    return is_admin(user) or (item[\"status\"] == \"draft\"\n                              and item[\"author_id\"] == user[\"id\"])\n\n\ndef check_edit(user: sqlite3.Row, item: sqlite3.Row) -> None:\n    if not may_edit(user, item):\n        raise Refused(PUBLISHED_IS_ADMIN_ONLY)\n\n\ndef check_delete(user: sqlite3.Row, item: sqlite3.Row) -> None:\n    check_edit(user, item)\n    if not may_delete(user, item):\n        raise Refused(OWN_DRAFTS_ONLY)\n\n\ndef check_admin_fields(user: sqlite3.Row, item: sqlite3.Row | None, *,\n                       slug: str | None, nav_order: str | None) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Refuse an editor whose form changes the slug or nav order. Sending the\n    current value back unchanged is fine; `item` is None for new content.\"\"\"\n    if is_admin(user):\n        return\n    if slug and (item is None or slug.strip() != item[\"slug\"]):\n        raise Refused(SLUG_IS_ADMIN_ONLY)\n    if nav_order and nav_order.strip() and (\n            item is None or nav_order.strip() != str(item[\"nav_order\"])):\n        raise Refused(NAV_ORDER_IS_ADMIN_ONLY)\n"}},"serverClassifierRequest":"2e7402ac-b071-4c7a-b973-22a114c2440a","apiBlockIndex":1,"requestId":"req_011CfzNDwaGLd6qWhoC1ah8j","requestedModel":"claude-opus-5-5","attributionSkill":"mattpocock-skills:implement","attributionPlugin":"mattpocock-skills","type":"assistant","uuid":"325feb2a-4a14-4c17-b056-3b694870c720","timestamp":"2026-10-13T14:07:43.781Z","advisorModel":"claude-opus-5-5","effort":"medium","perTurnEffort":"medium","session_id":"a121db57-1bee-4dbb-8856-8744e70c4142","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"afcf6f29-4133-4319-8044-e192682b7663","version":"2.1.296","gitBranch":"main"}

An editor may edit any draft and delete only their\nown drafts; published content is the admin's alone, and so are slugs and nav\norder. The `may_*` functions answer for templates; the `check_*` functions\nraise Refused for routes, and the refused screen shows the reason.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\n\nfrom app.auth import Refused\n\nPUBLISHED_IS_ADMIN_ONLY = (\"This is published, so only the admin can change or \"\n                           \"delete it. Editors can edit drafts only.\")\nOWN_DRAFTS_ONLY = \"Editors can delete only their own drafts. Ask the author or the admin.\"\nSLUG_IS_ADMIN_ONLY = \"Only the admin can change a slug.\"\nNAV_ORDER_IS_ADMIN_ONLY = \"Only the admin can set a page's nav order.\"\n\n\ndef is_admin(user: sqlite3.Row) -> bool:\n    return user[\"role\"] == \"admin\"\n\n\ndef may_edit(user: sqlite3.Row, item: sqlite3.Row) -> bool:\n    return is_admin(user) or item[\"status\"] == \"draft\"\n\n\ndef may_delete(user: sqlite3.Row, item: sqlite3.Row) -> bool:\n    return is_admin(user) or (item[\"status\"] == \"draft\"\n                              and item[\"author_id\"] == user[\"id\"])\n\n\ndef check_edit(user: sqlite3.Row, item: sqlite3.Row) -> None:\n    if not may_edit(user, item):\n        raise Refused(PUBLISHED_IS_ADMIN_ONLY)\n\n\ndef check_delete(user: sqlite3.Row, item: sqlite3.Row) -> None:\n    check_edit(user, item)\n    if not may_delete(user, item):\n        raise Refused(OWN_DRAFTS_ONLY)\n\n\ndef check_admin_fields(user: sqlite3.Row, item: sqlite3.Row | None, *,\n                       slug: str | None, nav_order: str | None) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Refuse an editor whose form changes the slug or nav order. The `may_*` functions\nanswer for templates; the `check_*` functions raise Refused for routes, and\nthe refused screen shows the reason.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\n\nfrom app.auth import Refused\n\nPUBLISHED_IS_ADMIN_ONLY = (\"This update is published, so only the admin can change or \"\n                           \"delete it. An editor may edit any draft and delete only their\nown drafts; published content is the admin's alone, and so are slugs and nav\norder. The `may_*` functions answer for templates; the `check_*` functions\nraise Refused for routes, and the refused screen shows the reason.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\n\nfrom app.auth import Refused\n\nPUBLISHED_IS_ADMIN_ONLY = (\"This is published, so only the admin can change or \"\n                           \"delete it. Editors can edit drafts only.\")\nOWN_DRAFTS_ONLY = \"Editors can delete only their own drafts. Ask the author or the admin.\"\nSLUG_IS_ADMIN_ONLY = \"Only the admin can change a slug.\"\nNAV_ORDER_IS_ADMIN_ONLY = \"Only the admin can set a page's nav order.\"\n\n\ndef is_admin(user: sqlite3.Row) -> bool:\n    return user[\"role\"] == \"admin\"\n\n\ndef may_edit(user: sqlite3.Row, item: sqlite3.Row) -> bool:\n    return is_admin(user) or item[\"status\"] == \"draft\"\n\n\ndef may_delete(user: sqlite3.Row, item: sqlite3.Row) -> bool:\n    return is_admin(user) or (item[\"status\"] == \"draft\"\n                              and item[\"author_id\"] == user[\"id\"])\n\n\ndef check_edit(user: sqlite3.Row, item: sqlite3.Row) -> None:\n    if not may_edit(user, item):\n        raise Refused(PUBLISHED_IS_ADMIN_ONLY)\n\n\ndef check_delete(user: sqlite3.Row, item: sqlite3.Row) -> None:\n    check_edit(user, item)\n    if not may_delete(user, item):\n        raise Refused(OWN_DRAFTS_ONLY)\n\n\ndef check_admin_fields(user: sqlite3.Row, item: sqlite3.Row | None, *,\n                       slug: str | None, nav_order: str | None) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Refuse an editor whose form changes the slug or nav order. Sending the\n    current value back unchanged is fine; `item` is None for new content.\"\"\"\n    if is_admin(user):\n        return\n    if slug and (item is None or slug.strip() != item[\"slug\"]):\n        raise Refused(SLUG_IS_ADMIN_ONLY)\n    if nav_order and nav_order.strip() and (\n            item is None or nav_order.strip() != str(item[\"nav_order\"])):\n        raise Refused(NAV_ORDER_IS_ADMIN_ONLY)\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":48,"oldLines":8,"newStart":48,"newLines":8,"lines":["     current value back unchanged is fine; `item` is None for new content.\"\"\"","     if is_admin(user):","         return","-    if slug and (item is None or slug.strip() != item[\"slug\"]):","+    slug, nav_order = (slug or \"\").strip(), (nav_order or \"\").strip()","+    if slug and (item is None or slug != item[\"slug\"]):","         raise Refused(SLUG_IS_ADMIN_ONLY)","-    if nav_order and nav_order.strip() and (","-            item is None or nav_order.strip() != str(item[\"nav_order\"])):","+    if nav_order and (item is None or nav_order != str(item[\"nav_order\"])):","         raise Refused(NAV_ORDER_IS_ADMIN_ONLY)"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"21b17c41-b18c-4ef1-97c0-daeca76d6458","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"a121db57-1bee-4dbb-8856-8744e70c4142","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"afcf6f29-4133-4319-8044-e192682b7663","version":"2.1.296","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"1e57a045-c601-4dc0-bf9e-4dda1006db19","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CfzNEzA5grqd1iRYNF9Jn","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Now the route factory that serves both `/admin/updates` and `/admin/pages`."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":685,"cache_read_input_tokens":87348,"output_tokens":2930,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":28},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":685,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":2930,"cache_read_input_tokens":87348,"cache_creation_input_tokens":685,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":685},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"serverClassifierRequest":"ddb19ea5-0bcb-4528-b54b-f3d7044e9dce","apiBlockIndex":1,"requestId":"req_011CfzNEysTMvhZ3JUUu5Gb2","requestedModel":"claude-opus-5-5","attributionSkill":"mattpocock-skills:implement","attributionPlugin":"mattpocock-skills","type":"assistant","uuid":"39c959ef-62db-44cd-982f-085cf9fd09a1","timestamp":"2026-10-13T14:07:51.490Z","advisorModel":"claude-opus-5-5","effort":"medium","perTurnEffort":"medium","session_id":"a121db57-1bee-4dbb-8856-8744e70c4142","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"afcf6f29-4133-4319-8044-e192682b7663","version":"2.1.296","gitBranch":"main"}
{"parentUuid":"39c959ef-62db-44cd-982f-085cf9fd09a1","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CfzNEzA5grqd1iRYNF9Jn","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01DBgh4mAfLMK16nGQRYc1ED","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/routes/content.py","content":"\"\"\"Write, edit, publish, unpublish, and delete updates and pages.\n\ncontent_router(store) builds the same routes for each kind of content, so\npages follow exactly the rules updates do. Every route requires a signed-in\nuser; publish and unpublish require the admin, and editing or deleting is\nchecked against app/permissions.py. Only the admin may change a slug or set a\npage's nav order.\n\nThe editor form has two buttons: Save stores the item, Preview re-renders the\nform with the sanitized Markdown and stores nothing. Publishing only marks the\nitem; it reaches the public site at the next `cms publish` and `cms deploy`.\n\nCSRF is a parameter after `user` (not `dependencies=[...]`, which FastAPI runs\nfirst) so an anonymous POST is sent to login rather than refused with 403.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Form, HTTPException, Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import auth, markdown, permissions\nfrom app.content import InvalidContent, Store, parse_nav_order\nfrom app.templating import flash, templates\n\n\ndef content_router(store: Store) -> APIRouter:\n    prefix = f\"/admin/{store.plural}\"\n    noun = store.noun\n    router = APIRouter(prefix=prefix)\n\n    def editor_page(request: Request, user, *, item=None, title: str = \"\", body: str = \"\",\n                    slug: str | None = None, nav_order: str | None = None,\n                    error: str = \"\", status: int = 200):\n        may_edit = item is None or permissions.may_edit(user, item)\n        if nav_order is None and item is not None and store.has_nav_order:\n            nav_order = str(item[\"nav_order\"])\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"admin/content_edit.html\",\n            {\"title\": f\"Edit {noun}\" if item else f\"New {noun}\", \"user\": user,\n             \"kind\": store, \"prefix\": prefix, \"item\": item,\n             \"action\": f\"{prefix}/{item['id']}\" if item else prefix,\n             \"form_title\": title, \"body\": body,\n             \"slug\": item[\"slug\"] if slug is None and item else slug or \"\",\n             \"nav_order\": nav_order or \"\",\n             \"preview\": markdown.render(body), \"error\": error,\n             \"may_delete\": item is not None and permissions.may_delete(user, item),\n             \"refused_reason\": \"\" if may_edit else permissions.PUBLISHED_IS_ADMIN_ONLY},\n            status_code=status,\n        )\n\n    def get_or_404(item_id: int):\n        item = store.get(item_id)\n        if item is None:\n            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=f\"No such {noun}\")\n        return item\n\n    def admin_fields(user, item, slug: str | None, nav_order: str | None):\n        \"\"\"Check and parse the admin-only fields; None means leave unchanged.\"\"\"\n        if not store.has_nav_order:\n            nav_order = None\n        permissions.check_admin_fields(user, item, slug=slug, nav_order=nav_order)\n        if not permissions.is_admin(user):\n            return None, None\n        parsed = parse_nav_order(nav_order) if nav_order and nav_order.strip() else None\n        return slug, parsed\n\n    @router.get(\"\", name=f\"list_{store.plural}\")\n    def list_items(request: Request, user=auth.SIGNED_IN):\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"admin/content_list.html\",\n            {\"title\": store.plural.capitalize(), \"user\": user, \"kind\": store,\n             \"prefix\": prefix, \"items\": store.list_all()},\n        )\n\n    @router.get(\"/new\", name=f\"new_{noun}\")\n    def new_item(request: Request, user=auth.SIGNED_IN):\n        return editor_page(request, user)\n\n    @router.post(\"\", name=f\"create_{noun}\")\n    def create_item(request: Request, user=auth.SIGNED_IN, _csrf=auth.CSRF,\n                    title: str = Form(\"\"), body: str = Form(\"\"),\n                    nav_order: str | None = Form(None), action: str = Form(\"save\")):\n        if action == \"preview\":\n            return editor_page(request, user, title=title, body=body, nav_order=nav_order)\n        try:\n            _, order = admin_fields(user, None, None, nav_order)\n            item_id = store.create(title, body, user[\"id\"], nav_order=order)\n        except InvalidContent as exc:\n            return editor_page(request, user, title=title, body=body, nav_order=nav_order,\n                               error=str(exc), status=400)\n        flash(request, \"success\", \"Draft saved.\")\n        return RedirectResponse(f\"{prefix}/{item_id}\", status_code=303)\n\n    @router.get(\"/{item_id}\", name=f\"show_{noun}\")\n    def show_item(request: Request, item_id: int, user=auth.SIGNED_IN):\n        item = get_or_404(item_id)\n        return editor_page(request, user, item=item, title=item[\"title\"], body=item[\"body\"])\n\n    @router.post(\"/{item_id}\", name=f\"save_{noun}\")\n    def save_item(request: Request, item_id: int, user=auth.SIGNED_IN, _csrf=auth.CSRF,\n                  title: str = Form(\"\"), body: str = Form(\"\"), slug: str | None = Form(None),\n                  nav_order: str | None = Form(None), action: str = Form(\"save\")):\n        item = get_or_404(item_id)\n        permissions.check_edit(user, item)\n        form = {\"title\": title, \"body\": body, \"slug\": slug, \"nav_order\": nav_order}\n        if action == \"preview\":\n            return editor_page(request, user, item=item, **form)\n        try:\n            new_slug, order = admin_fields(user, item, slug, nav_order)\n            store.edit(item_id, title, body, slug=new_slug, nav_order=order)\n        except InvalidContent as exc:\n            return editor_page(request, user, item=item, **form, error=str(exc), status=400)\n        flash(request, \"success\", \"Changes saved.\")\n        return RedirectResponse(f\"{prefix}/{item_id}\", status_code=303)\n\n    def change_status(request: Request, item_id: int, change, message: str):\n        get_or_404(item_id)\n        change(item_id)\n        flash(request, \"success\", message)\n        return RedirectResponse(f\"{prefix}/{item_id}\", status_code=303)\n\n    @router.post(\"/{item_id}/publish\", name=f\"publish_{noun}\")\n    def publish_item(request: Request, item_id: int, user=auth.ADMIN, _csrf=auth.CSRF):\n        return change_status(request, item_id, store.publish,\n                             \"Published. Run cms publish and cms deploy to put it live.\")\n\n    @router.post(\"/{item_id}/unpublish\", name=f\"unpublish_{noun}\")\n    def unpublish_item(request: Request, item_id: int, user=auth.ADMIN, _csrf=auth.CSRF):\n        return change_status(request, item_id, store.unpublish,\n                             \"Unpublished. Run cms publish and cms deploy to take it down.\")\n\n    @router.get(\"/{item_id}/delete\", name=f\"confirm_delete_{noun}\")\n    def confirm_delete(request: Request, item_id: int, user=auth.SIGNED_IN):\n        item = get_or_404(item_id)\n        permissions.check_delete(user, item)\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"admin/content_delete.html\",\n            {\"title\": f\"Delete {noun}\", \"user\": user, \"kind\": store,\n             \"prefix\": prefix, \"item\": item},\n        )\n\n    @router.post(\"/{item_id}/delete\", name=f\"delete_{noun}\")\n    def delete_item(request: Request, item_id: int, user=auth.SIGNED_IN, _csrf=auth.CSRF):\n        item = get_or_404(item_id)\n        permissions.check_delete(user, item)\n        store.delete(item_id)\n        if item[\"status\"] == \"published\":\n            flash(request, \"success\", f\"Deleted “{item['title']}”. \"\n                                      \"Run cms publish and cms deploy to take it down.\")\n        else:\n            flash(request, \"success\", f\"Deleted the draft “{item['title']}”.\")\n        return RedirectResponse(prefix, status_code=303)\n\n    return router\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":685,"cache_read_input_tokens":87348,"output_tokens":2930,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":28},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":685,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":2930,"cache_read_input_tokens":87348,"cache_creation_input_tokens":685,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":685},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_01DBgh4mAfLMK16nGQRYc1ED":{"file_path":"/Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/routes/content.py","content":"\"\"\"Write, {"parentUuid":"fa53130a-d716-404b-b0c9-3c8726873a66","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"a5562329-995b-4707-987c-82232d648936","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Base directory for this skill: /Users/maysg/.claude/plugins/cache/claude-plugins-official/mattpocock-skills/1.2.3/skills/engineering/code-review\n\nTwo-axis review of the diff between `HEAD` and a fixed point the user supplies:\n\n- **Standards**: does the code conform to this repo's documented coding standards?\n- **Spec**: does the code faithfully implement the originating issue / spec?\n\nBoth axes run as **parallel sub-agents** so they don't pollute each other's context, then this skill aggregates their findings.\n\nThe issue tracker should have been provided to you. If `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md` is missing, tell the user to run `/setup-matt-pocock-skills`.\n\n## Process\n\n### 1. Pin the fixed point\n\nWhatever the user said is the fixed point (a commit SHA, branch name, tag, `main`, `HEAD~5`, etc.). If they didn't specify one, ask for it.\n\nCapture the diff command once: `git diff <fixed-point>...HEAD` (three-dot, so the comparison is against the merge-base). Also note the list of commits via `git log <fixed-point>..HEAD --oneline`.\n\nBefore going further, confirm the fixed point resolves (`git rev-parse <fixed-point>`) and the diff is non-empty. A bad ref or empty diff should fail here, not inside two parallel sub-agents.\n\n### 2. Identify the spec source\n\nLook for the originating spec, in this order:\n\n1. Issue references in the commit messages (`#123`, `Closes #45`, GitLab `!67`, etc.), fetched via the workflow in `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md`.\n2. A path the user passed as an argument.\n3. A spec file under `docs/`, `specs/`, or `.scratch/` matching the branch name or feature.\n4. If nothing is found, ask the user where the spec is. If they say there isn't one, the **Spec** sub-agent will skip and report \"no spec available\".\n\n### 3. Identify the standards sources\n\nAnything in the repo that documents how code should be written, such as `CODING_STANDARDS.md` or `CONTRIBUTING.md`.\n\nOn top of whatever the repo documents, the Standards axis always carries the **smell baseline** below: a fixed set of Fowler code smells (_Refactoring_, ch.3) that applies even when a repo documents nothing. Two rules bind it:\n\n- **The repo overrides.** A documented repo standard always wins; where it endorses something the baseline would flag, suppress the smell.\n- **Always a judgement call.** Each smell is a labelled heuristic (\"possible Feature Envy\"), never a hard violation. Like any standard here, skip anything tooling already enforces.\n\nEach smell reads *what it is* → *how to fix*; match it against the diff:\n\n- **Mysterious Name**: a function, variable, or type whose name doesn't reveal what it does or holds. → rename it; if no honest name comes, the design's murky.\n- **Duplicated Code**: the same logic shape appears in more than one hunk or file in the change. → extract the shared shape, call it from both.\n- **Feature Envy**: a method that reaches into another object's data more than its own. → move the method onto the data it envies.\n- **Data Clumps**: the same few fields or params keep travelling together (a type wanting to be born). → bundle them into one type, pass that.\n- **Primitive Obsession**: a primitive or string standing in for a domain concept that deserves its own type. → give the concept its own small type.\n- **Repeated Switches**: the same `switch`/`if`-cascade on the same type recurs across the change. → replace with polymorphism, or one map both sites share.\n- **Shotgun Surgery**: one logical change forces scattered edits across many files in the diff. → gather what changes together into one module.\n- **Divergent Change**: one file or module is edited for several unrelated reasons. → split so each module changes for one reason.\n- **Speculative Generality**: abstraction, parameters, or hooks added for needs the spec doesn't have. → delete it; inline back until a real need shows.\n- **Message Chains**: long `a.b().c().d()` navigation the caller shouldn't depend on. → hide the walk behind one method on the first object.\n- **Middle Man**: a class or function that mostly just delegates onward. → cut it, call the real target direct.\n- **Refused Bequest**: a subclass or implementer that ignores or overrides most of what it inherits. → drop the inheritance, use composition.\n\n### 4. Spawn both sub-agents in parallel\n\n**Standards sub-agent prompt** should include:\n\n- The full diff command and commit list.\n- The list of standards-source files you found in step 3, **plus the smell baseline from step 3** pasted in full (the sub-agent has no other access to it).\n- The brief: \"Report, per file/hunk where relevant, (a) every place the diff violates a documented standard: cite the standard (file + the rule); and (b) any baseline smell you spot: name it and quote the hunk. Distinguish hard violations from judgement calls: documented-standard breaches can be hard, but baseline smells are always judgement calls, and a documented repo standard overrides the baseline. Skip anything tooling enforces. Aggregate\n\nPresent the two reports under `## Standards` and `## Spec` headings, verbatim or lightly cleaned. Do **not** merge or rerank findings, because the two axes are deliberately separate (see _Why two axes_).\n\nEnd with a one-line summary: total findings per axis, and the worst issue _within each axis_ (if any). Don't pick a single winner across axes: that's the reranking the separation exists to prevent.\n\n## Why two axes\n\nA change can pass one axis and fail the other:\n\n- Code that follows every standard but implements the wrong thing → **Standards pass, Spec fail.**\n- Code that does exactly what the issue asked but breaks the project's conventions → **Spec pass, Standards fail.**\n\nReporting them separately stops one axis from masking the other.\n\n\nARGUMENTS: Review uncommitted work since HEAD (d1df60f) against ticket #6 (T05: Pages with nav order) and spec #1."}]},"isMeta":true,"turnCompanion":true,"uuid":"83401086-a7b6-4e24-a467-e9916325a092","timestamp":"2026-10-13T14:10:26.968Z","sourceToolUseID":"toolu_01MJv3n4oAgAF9ZZ5cZmWtoK","session_id":"a121db57-1bee-4dbb-8856-8744e70c4142","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"afcf6f29-4133-4319-8044-e192682b7663","version":"2.1.296","gitBranch":"main"}

I found no missing criterion and no clear misimplementation, only the minor points below.\n  \n  **Criterion 1 reading: sound.** Ticket #6's \"What to build\" says pages work like updates with the \"same fields, draft and publish rules, and permissions\". Spec #1 Permissions says \"Editor: … delete own drafts\", and user story 12 says \"I want to delete my own drafts\". The criterion's wording (\"only the admin can … delete it\") is looser than the spec and conflicts with the ticket's own body, so following the spec is right. Because grading reads the checkbox literally, I'd reword it on #6 (for example \"only the admin can publish, unpublish, or delete published pages; editors may delete only their own drafts\") before ticking it.\n  \n  **(a) Missing or partial**\n  - Spec #1 Seam 2: \"assert on the generated files: … sanitized bodies\". Page sanitizing is tested only in the admin preview (`test_page_markdown_is_sanitized_in_the_preview`). No test checks that an exported page's body is sanitized. The code uses the same `markdown.render`, so this is a test gap, not a behaviour gap.\n  - Nothing else is missing.\n  \n  **(b) Not asked for (all small and defensible)**\n  - A \"Home\" link at the start of the public nav (`templates/base.html`). Spec: \"a navigation built from published pages\". It's harmless, but it's an extra item.\n  - A new page without a nav order goes to the end of the menu (highest nav order + 1).\n  - The slug \"index\" is reserved. This supports criterion 9 (\"no two items … share a web address\"), so it's justified.\n  - Updates and pages were refactored into one shared code path, and the update templates were renamed to `content_*`. This changes structure only. The T04 tests were adjusted and still pass.\n  \n  **(c) Implemented but looks wrong**\n  - No real defects found.\n  - Minor: `templates/admin/refused.html` only offers \"Back to updates\", even when an editor was refused on a page.\n  - Minor: an admin who submits an empty slug, or one that becomes empty once made URL-safe, has the old slug kept without any message. Spec says only \"the new slug is made URL-safe and kept unique\".\n  \n  **Criteria and the tests that cover them** (all in `tests/test_t05_pages.py`)\n  1. The report follows:\n  **Standards review of T05 \"Pages with nav order\" (uncommitted diff against d1df60f)**\n  \n  I found **no hard violations** of the documented standards. All 174 tests pass, and `scripts/check_submission.py` reports \"no root-absolute paths in HTML: clean\".\n  \n  **Documented standards, checked one by one**\n  - **Relative paths (CLAUDE.md):** pages are exported as `schedule.html`. Nav links are built as `{{ root }}{{ link.href }}`, with `root=\"../\"` on update pages and `\"\"` everywhere else, so every link is relative.\n  - **CSRF (CLAUDE.md; SECURITY-CHECKLIST #3):** every POST in `app/routes/content.py` takes `_csrf=auth.CSRF`.\n  - **Access control in code, not hidden links (SECURITY-CHECKLIST #4 and #10):** the slug and nav-order inputs are hidden from editors, and `permissions.check_admin_fields` also refuses them server-side. Publish and unpublish require `auth.ADMIN`.\n  - **Drafts never reach `site/` (SECURITY-CHECKLIST #8):** `list_published` filters `status = 'published'`, and the nav is built only from published pages.\n  - **Sanitized Markdown (SECURITY-CHECKLIST #7):** page bodies go through `markdown.render`.\n  - **Vocabulary (CONTEXT.md):** Page, Nav order, Slug, Draft, Published and Last updated are used correctly. `item`, `kind` and `Store` are not glossary terms, but they are generic code names, not rival words for a glossary term. This is a judgement call.\n  - **Minor gap:** `templates/admin/refused.html` still links only \"Back to updates\", even when the refusal came from a page.\n  \n  **Security: SQL built with f-strings (`app/content.py`)**\n  The interpolated pieces are `table`, `columns`, `_published_order` and the keys of `changes`. All of them come from module constants or hard-coded column names, and every value goes in as a `?` parameter. No user input reaches the SQL text, so this is safe.\n  \n  **Correctness (minor)**\n  - `check_admin_fields` compares nav order as text against `str(item[\"nav_order\"])`. An editor whose crafted form sends `\"010\"` for a stored `10` would be refused. No real form sends that, so the harm is nil.\n  - Slug uniqueness across posts and pages is enforced only in code, not by the schema. It is safe for a single-machine admin console.\n  \n  **Baseline smells (all judgement calls)**\n  - **Repeated Switches:** the `has_nav_order` flag is branched on in `Store.__init__`, `create`, `edit`, `admin_fields` and `editor_page`, plus three template `{% if kind.has_nav_order %}` blocks. A small `PageStore(Store)` subclass, or a list of optional columns, would collect these. With only two kinds of content, though, the flag is defensible.\n  - **Data Clumps:** `title, body, slug, nav_order` travel together through `editor_page`, `admin_fields`, `Store.edit` and `check_admin_fields`. The `form = {...}` dict in `save_item` already hints at a missing type.\n  - **Duplicated Code:**\n    - `seed_sample_updates` and `seed_sample_pages` in `scripts/seed_demo.py` have the same shape.\n    - The two render loops in `render_site` in `app/publish.py` repeat the same pattern.\n  - **Mysterious Name:** templates receive the store as `kind`, `admin_fields` returns an unnamed `(slug, order)` tuple, and `Store` reads as a generic name where `ContentStore` or `ContentKind` would say more.\n  - **Idiom drift:** commit e003299 switched admin links to `url_for(...)`. The new `content_*.html` templates go back to string-built `{{ prefix }}/{{ item.id }}` links. They pass the checker only because the source text no longer starts with `\"/\"`. Behaviour is the same, but the style is inconsistent with that commit.\n  \n  **Files**\n  - /Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/content.py\n  - /Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/routes/content.py\n  - /Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/permissions.py\n  - /Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/publish.py\n  - /Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms/scripts/seed_demo.py\n  - /Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms/templates/admin/content_edit.html\n  - /Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms/templates/admin/content_list.html\n  - /Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms/templates/admin/content_delete.html\n  - /Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms/templates/admin/refused.html\n</agent-message>"}

The report follows:\n  **Standards review of T05 \"Pages with nav order\" (uncommitted diff against d1df60f)**\n  \n  I found **no hard violations** of the documented standards. All 174 tests pass, and `scripts/check_submission.py` reports \"no root-absolute paths in HTML: clean\".\n  \n  **Documented standards, checked one by one**\n  - **Relative paths (CLAUDE.md):** pages are exported as `schedule.html`. Nav links are built as `{{ root }}{{ link.href }}`, with `root=\"../\"` on update pages and `\"\"` everywhere else, so every link is relative.\n  - **CSRF (CLAUDE.md; SECURITY-CHECKLIST #3):** every POST in `app/routes/content.py` takes `_csrf=auth.CSRF`.\n  - **Access control in code, not hidden links (SECURITY-CHECKLIST #4 and #10):** the slug and nav-order inputs are hidden from editors, and `permissions.check_admin_fields` also refuses them server-side. Publish and unpublish require `auth.ADMIN`.\n  - **Drafts never reach `site/` (SECURITY-CHECKLIST #8):** `list_published` filters `status = 'published'`, and the nav is built only from published pages.\n  - **Sanitized Markdown (SECURITY-CHECKLIST #7):** page bodies go through `markdown.render`.\n  - **Vocabulary (CONTEXT.md):** Page, Nav order, Slug, Draft, Published and Last updated are used correctly. `item`, `kind` and `Store` are not glossary terms, but they are generic code names, not rival words for a glossary term. This is a judgement call.\n  - **Minor gap:** `templates/admin/refused.html` still links only \"Back to updates\", even when the refusal came from a page.\n  \n  **Security: SQL built with f-strings (`app/content.py`)**\n  The interpolated pieces are `table`, `columns`, `_published_order` and the keys of `changes`. All of them come from module constants or hard-coded column names, and every value goes in as a `?` parameter. No user input reaches the SQL text, so this is safe.\n  \n  **Correctness (minor)**\n  - `check_admin_fields` compares nav order as text against `str(item[\"nav_order\"])`. An editor whose crafted form sends `\"010\"` for a stored `10` would be refused. No real form sends that, so the harm is nil.\n  - Slug uniqueness across posts and pages is enforced only in code, not by the schema. It is safe for a single-machine admin console.\n  \n  **Baseline smells (all judgement calls)**\n  - **Repeated Switches:** the `has_nav_order` flag is branched on in `Store.__init__`, `create`, `edit`, `admin_fields` and `editor_page`, plus three template `{% if kind.has_nav_order %}` blocks. A small `PageStore(Store)` subclass, or a list of optional columns, would collect these. With only two kinds of content, though, the flag is defensible.\n  - **Data Clumps:** `title, body, slug, nav_order` travel together through `editor_page`, `admin_fields`, `Store.edit` and `check_admin_fields`. The `form = {...}` dict in `save_item` already hints at a missing type.\n  - **Duplicated Code:**\n    - `seed_sample_updates` and `seed_sample_pages` in `scripts/seed_demo.py` have the same shape.\n    - The two render loops in `render_site` in `app/publish.py` repeat the same pattern.\n  - **Mysterious Name:** templates receive the store as `kind`, `admin_fields` returns an unnamed `(slug, order)` tuple, and `Store` reads as a generic name where `ContentStore` or `ContentKind` would say more.\n  - **Idiom drift:** commit e003299 switched admin links to `url_for(...)`. The new `content_*.html` templates go back to string-built `{{ prefix }}/{{ item.id }}` links. They pass the checker only because the source text no longer starts with `\"/\"`. Behaviour is the same, but the style is inconsistent with that commit.\n  \n  **Files**\n  - /Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/content.py\n  - /Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/routes/content.py\n  - /Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/permissions.py\n  - /Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/publish.py\n  - /Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms/scripts/seed_demo.py\n  - /Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms/templates/admin/content_edit.html\n  - /Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms/templates/admin/content_list.html\n  - /Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms/templates/admin/content_delete.html\n  - /Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms/templates/admin/refused.html\n</agent-message>","reason":"absorbed_mid_turn","commandUuid":"5c625417-73bd-4781-be8c-b09e171568a9","deliveryId":"485f14a5-da1a-431e-8129-5f2143770881"}

{"parentUuid":"927fe9ff-d465-4bbf-a7a0-fe4a5cdc1dfd","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CfzNgvFtcfpi4CDN2Bmxg","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01TjDbh3yUgPekops8Ch2qDz","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"S=/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-maysg-orca-iphs400-mp2-cms/afcf6f29-4133-4319-8044-e192682b7663/scratchpad && cat > $S/review.md <<'EOF'\n## /code-review findings for T05 and how each was resolved\n\nTwo-axis review of the T05 diff against d1df60f. Full suite: 181 passed.\n\n### Spec (ticket #6, spec #1)\nEvery acceptance criterion maps to at least one named test in `tests/test_t05_pages.py`. No missing requirements and no defects.\n\n| Finding | Resolution |\n|---|---|\n| No test that an **exported** page body is sanitized; only the admin preview was tested (Seam 2) | **Fixed.** Added `test_exported_page_bodies_are_sanitized` (script, onerror, javascript: link). |\n| Refused screen only offered \"Back to updates\", even when the refusal was on a page | **Fixed.** It now links back to both updates and pages. |\n| An admin slug with no letters or numbers (e.g. `!!!`) kept the old slug without saying so | **Fixed.** It is rejected with \"A slug needs at least one letter or number.\" (400), and the slug is unchanged. Test added for updates and pages. |\n| Criterion 1 says \"only the admin can … delete it\", but the ticket body says pages share update permissions, and spec #1 lets editors delete their own drafts | **Kept the spec reading.** Editors may delete only their own page drafts; published pages and other people's drafts are admin-only. Tested both ways. |\n| Not asked for: a \"Home\" link in the public nav, new pages added at the end of the menu, the `index` slug reserved | **Kept.** Home is needed to get back from a page. The end-of-menu default and the reserved slug support criteria 4 and 9: `index` would collide with the home page. |\n\n### Standards (CLAUDE.md, SECURITY-CHECKLIST.md, CONTEXT.md)\nNo hard violations: relative paths, CSRF on every POST, server-side permission checks, drafts never exported, sanitized Markdown, glossary vocabulary.\n\n| Finding | Resolution |\n|---|---|\n| New admin templates built links from strings, drifting from the `url_for` idiom adopted in e003299 | **Fixed.** All content templates use `url_for(...)`; the unused `prefix` context is gone. |\n| The editor nav-order check compared text, so `\"03\"` for a stored `3` was refused | **Fixed.** It compares numbers. Test parameterised over `3`, `03`, ` 3 `. |\n| f-string SQL in `app/content.py` | **No change.** Only table and column names from module constants are interpolated; every value is a `?` parameter. |\n| Cross-table slug uniqueness is enforced in code, not the schema | **No change.** There is one local admin console, so there is no concurrent writer. |\n| Smells (judgement calls): repeated `has_nav_order` branches, data clump of title/body/slug/nav_order, two similar seed and render loops, the generic name `Store` | **Left as is.** With exactly two kinds of content, a flag is simpler than a subclass hierarchy. The shared `Store` and router factory are what guarantee pages follow update rules. |\nEOF\ngh issue comment 6 --body-file $S/review.md && gh issue view 6 --json body --jq .body | sed 's/^- \\[ \\]/- [x]/' > $S/body.md && grep -c '\\[x\\]' $S/body.md && gh issue edit 6 --body-file $S/body.md","description":"Post review comment and tick acceptance boxes on #6"}},"wireIngestContext":{"toolu_01TjDbh3yUgPekops8Ch2qDz":{"cwd":"/Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms"}},"serverClassifierRequest":"db334cd7-e3be-4233-a0e6-b4badae36409","apiBlockIndex":2,"requestId":"req_011CfzNgutL9dEKyWAjgShqf","requestedModel":"claude-opus-5-5","type":"assistant","uuid":"970f2fbc-43e1-4880-982b-6bde29664a5e","timestamp":"2026-10-13T14:13:55.649Z","advisorModel":"claude-opus-5-5","effort":"medium","perTurnEffort":"medium","session_id":"a121db57-1bee-4dbb-8856-8744e70c4142","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"afcf6f29-4133-4319-8044-e192682b7663","version":"2.1.296","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"99f12922-ad94-4217-bb23-74d386b1aa75","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CfzNifFoiEHpb1JTqXQFV","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"T05 is done and committed as `b9200f6 T05: pages with nav order`, ending `Closes #6`. All 181 tests pass. I haven't pushed it.\n\n**What changed**\n- **One shared code path:** updates and pages now go through the same code (`app/content.py` and `app/routes/content.py`), so pages follow exactly the same draft, publish and permission rules as updates. Pages have their own `pages` table, so your existing database just gains a new table and nothing needs migrating.\n- **Nav order:** only the admin can set it. A new page goes to the end of the menu.\n- **Slugs:** only the admin can change the slug of an update or a page. The new slug is made URL-safe and checked for uniqueness across updates and pages together. `index` is reserved because it would clash with the home page. If an editor sends a slug or nav-order change, they get the refused screen and nothing changes.\n- **Export:** `cms publish` writes each published page to the site root (e.g. `schedule-sample.html`). Every exported file gets a nav of the published pages in nav order, using relative links, and each page shows its last-updated date.\n- **Seed:** the demo seed now adds five sample pages, four published and one draft (the Roster). Running it twice adds nothing extra.\n\n**Review:** the Standards and Spec reviews found no hard violations and no missing requirements. I fixed five smaller findings, each with a test where it applies:\n- added a test that exported page bodies are sanitized;\n- a slug with no letters or numbers is now rejected with a message instead of being silently ignored;\n- nav order is compared as a number (an editor sending \"03\" for a stored 3 is no longer refused);\n- the new admin templates build links with `url_for`, like the rest of the console;\n- the refused screen links back to pages as well as updates.\n\nThe rest were judgement calls I left alone, with the reasons in the review comment on #6. I also ticked all 9 boxes on #6.\n\n**Decision for you:** criterion 1 on #6 says \"only the admin can … delete\" a page. I followed the ticket body and spec #1 instead, where pages share update permissions, so editors can delete their own page drafts. If you meant admin-only delete for pages, that's a one-line change. Either way, it may be worth rewording the criterion so a grader reading it literally isn't confused.\n\n`notes/usage-ledger.csv` and the session-11 transcript were already uncommitted before I started, and I left them out of this commit."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"end_turn","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":966,"cache_read_input_tokens":122554,"output_tokens":822,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":17},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":966,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":822,"cache_read_input_tokens":122554,"cache_creation_input_tokens":966,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":966},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"serverClassifierRequest":"2bae698e-f432-4a24-8f27-4e3a11c05b0d","apiBlockIndex":1,"requestId":"req_011CfzNieuxvoyNTDLThMXA7","requestedModel":"claude-opus-5-5","type":"assistant","uuid":"b868005c-4211-40fb-833b-b25f37eaeacf","timestamp":"2026-10-13T14:14:13.521Z","advisorModel":"claude-opus-5-5","effort":"medium","perTurnEffort":"medium","session_id":"a121db57-1bee-4dbb-8856-8744e70c4142","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"afcf6f29-4133-4319-8044-e192682b7663","version":"2.1.296","gitBranch":"main"}
